theorem lg_target (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) ≥ 4 := by
  rw [one_div_add_one_div ha hb]
  rw [mul_assoc]
  have h : (a + b) * (a + b) / (a * b) ≥ 4 :=
    by
      rw [mul_comm (a * b) (a + b)]
      have h1 : (a + b) * (a + b) ≥ 4 * (a * b) :=
        by apply Real.mul_self_le_add_two_mul_add_mul_self ha hb
      rw [mul_right_inj' (a * b)] at h1
      exact h1
  exact h
